questions.question: As Israel left Egypt, which man did the Ammonites and Moabites hire to curse them?
Moses told Israel that the LORD walks throughout their camp. What does he say God does there?

answers.text: Protects them and hands over their enemies
Counts the soldiers in every tribe
Settles the arguments in every tent

questions.question: If a slave escaped his master and took refuge in Israel, where did Moses say he could live?

answers.text: In the town his master picks
In a town set apart for slaves

questions.question: Moses told Israel not to charge interest to their brothers. Who were they allowed to charge interest?
